Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Cloud Engineer role at BeyondTrust. With hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, Terraform, and CI/CD automation, I specialize in building secure, scalable platforms and automated deployment workflows.

At Top Fresher Pvt Ltd, I architected a centralized CI/CD platform using GitHub Actions with 15+ reusable workflows, achieving 90% code reuse across projects. Additionally, I designed self-hosted runners with auto-termination, which reduced cloud costs by 40%. On the networking and security side, I implemented secure cloud infrastructure using VPCs, Load Balancers, and WireGuard VPN, while enforcing centralized authentication and secrets management through Keycloak and HashiCorp Vault. I also managed Kubernetes clusters with RBAC and established monitoring using Prometheus and Grafana.

I am eager to bring my background in AWS, Terraform automation, and infrastructure security to support BeyondTrust's mission-critical cloud environments. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Leo Stanley S
